name: com.unity.collab-proxy
description: The package gives you the ability to use Unity Version Control in the Unity editor. To use Unity Version Control, a subscription is required. Learn more about how you can get started for free by visiting https://unity.com/solutions/version-control

_upm.changelog:
### Added

- Added compatibility with Unity Editors running on CoreCLR.
- Added a new dialog to invite members to cloud project.
- Added the Annotate option to the context menus across all views.
- Added asset status icons for HierarchyV2.
- Added deep link support for Unity Hub links.
- Added the Unity Version Control skill for Unity AI Assistant, with a banner to enable it.

### Changed

- Migrated the Pending Changes comment area, toolbar, and file list to UI Toolkit.

### Fixed

- Fixed the handling of the Unity process PATH environment variable when the desktop app is installed.
- Fixed icon file naming to use only ASCII characters.
- Fixed asset diffs so loaded objects no longer affect the open scene.
- Fixed the release of cached icon textures on domain reload.
- Fixed the startup behavior so the Unity Version Control window only opens when needed.
- Fixed the reopening of IMGUI tabs so they always attach to the correct parent window.
- Fixed Editor responsiveness while waiting for pending operations.
- Fixed restoring the Differences window from a previous session.
- Fixed the layout of the "How do you prefer to work" text when creating a workspace.
- Fixed the cleanup of the Unity Version Control window updater.
- Fixed Windows x86 player builds ensuring that all package's Editor-only libraries are excluded.
